name: Test Defaults and Patches
author: ct
description: Test fixture of the property patches system: a targeted patch (Marao, food/ration) and wildcard patches of every character and item. Marked as a fixture, so --all-mods and games never load it; the property_patches itest loads it explicitly (--with-mods=test_defaults_and_patches --itest=property_patches) and checks the merged entities.
